alt: 同一處海岸在不同年代有了巨大變化：曾經是海水與漁船，後來成了田地，如今又出現城鎮。
scene_prompt: 滄海桑田 means enormous changes over time, literally sea becoming farmland. Three softly blended horizontal storybook vignettes in one landscape illustration, showing the SAME recognizable hill ridge and oddly shaped standing rock across eras. LEFT the valley below the ridge is a blue sea inlet with a tiny fishing boat; CENTER much later it is reclaimed green farmland with mulberry trees; RIGHT in modern times a modest town and gardens occupy the same valley. An elderly present-day resident at lower right holds an old picture of the former sea inlet and looks thoughtfully across today's scene. No dates, words, numbers, arrows, labels or specific real location. Emphasize drastic passage-of-time transformation, not environmental catastrophe or flooding.
